zh.description: 找回自己写过的 Prompt、模型的回答和当时的上下文。把散落在对话里的灵感，重新放回手边。
zh.intro: 有些问题问得很好，有些回答值得再读。Prompts 是我给自己做的 Codex 对话检索工具，让已经发生过的思考，可以在需要的时候再次派上用场。
features: 找回一句话
按关键词搜索自己写过的 Prompt 或模型回答，也可以在不同项目之间查找。
把上下文一起带回来
展开匹配的消息，阅读前后对话，再回到原来的任务。
留在自己的电脑上
索引本机保存的对话，不依赖嵌入模型或额外的 API Key。
zh.note: 目前是自用的本地插件，公开安装入口正在整理。

en.tagline: A good question deserves a second life.
en.description: Find your prompts, model replies, and the conversations around them. Bring a useful thought back within reach.
en.intro: Some questions are worth asking again. Some answers are worth keeping. I made Prompts to search my own Codex conversations and return to ideas when I need them.
features: Find a thought
Search prompts and replies by keyword, within a project or across projects.
Keep the context
Read the surrounding conversation, then open the original task.
Keep it local
Search conversations saved on your computer, without an embedding model or an extra API key.
en.note: A personal local plugin. A public installation link is being prepared.

zh.tagline: 把「下次见」，变成一个具体的日子。
zh.description: 一份给朋友的见面邀请。选个时间，挑件想一起做的事，让约会从一句话开始发生。
zh.intro: 也叫「Date with Milo · 和安乐约个会」。把来回商量的时间和安排，放进一张可以慢慢填写的邀请里。见面、散步、吃点东西，或者只是远程聊聊天。
features: 先留出时间
从日历和可选时段开始，为一次相处留出位置。
一起做点什么
选一个活动方向，写下自己的主意，或者把安排交给我。
让邀请有个落点
留下称呼和联系邮箱，回看这次约会的具体安排。
zh.note: 一份给重要朋友的邀请。公开体验入口正在整理。

en.description: An invitation for friends. Pick a time and something to do together, and turn a passing thought into a plan.
en.intro: Also called Date with Milo. An invitation that gives the back-and-forth of making plans a little room: meet up, take a walk, share a meal, or simply catch up online.
features: Make time
Start with a date and an available time slot.
Make a little plan
Choose an activity, suggest your own idea, or leave the planning to me.
Bring it together
Add your name and email, then review the details of the invitation.
en.note: An invitation for people I care about. A public link is being prepared.

zh.tagline: 把此刻的文字与画面，加入音乐。
zh.description: 写下一段感受，或上传一张图片。让每一次输入化作新的音乐声部，改变背景音乐的情绪与走向。
zh.intro: 把感受当作食材，把音乐当作一份慢慢生长的配方。写下一段关于气味、光线、触感或记忆的文字，也可以上传一张图片，让这一刻的情绪进入正在播放的音乐。
features: 文字，或一张图
描述此刻的心情与感官记忆，或上传 PNG、JPEG、WebP 图片，作为音乐的情绪输入。
一层一层，成为音乐
每次输入都会加入独立的音乐声部，与已有声音叠加，让节奏、音色和氛围逐渐改变。
留下情绪的谱子
在声部图与情绪记录里，回看提交过的文字、图片和情绪标签；也可以移除某次输入对应的声部。
zh.note: 图片内容的解读需要启用图像理解服务；未启用或分析失败时，使用默认图片情绪。在线体验入口正在整理。

en.tagline: Add a moment to the music.
en.description: Write a feeling or upload an image. Each input becomes a new musical layer, changing the mood and direction of the background sound.
en.intro: Treat a feeling as an ingredient, and music as a recipe that keeps growing. Describe a scent, a texture, a memory, or a kind of light — or upload an image — and let that moment become part of the music.
features: Words, or a picture
Describe a mood or a sensory memory, or upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image as an emotional input.
Build a piece, layer by layer
Each entry adds an independent musical layer alongside earlier sounds, gradually changing the rhythm, timbre, and atmosphere.
Keep an emotional score
Revisit submitted words, images, and mood labels in the layer map and emotional archive, or remove an entry and its musical layer.
en.note: Interpreting image content requires an enabled vision service. When it is unavailable or analysis fails, images use a default mood. A public link is being prepared.

zh.tagline: 借一张图的颜色，讲自己的故事。
zh.description: 把喜欢的参考图变成照片的色彩灵感。迁移色调、调整强度，再把这份氛围带回自己的创作。
zh.intro: 遇到一张喜欢的照片时，常常最先被它的颜色打动。Color Muse 试着把这种直觉变成一个小工具：给它一张参考图，看看自己的照片能长出什么样的色彩。
features: 从喜欢的颜色开始
上传自己的照片，选择预设风格或一张自己的参考图。
找到刚好的程度
调整迁移强度，对比处理前后的色彩，让氛围适合自己的画面。
带回创作流程
下载处理后的图片，或导出 .CUBE LUT，继续在其他调色工具中使用。
zh.note: 图像处理在浏览器中进行。项目源码已提供，在线体验入口待补充。

en.tagline: Borrow a palette. Tell your own story.
en.description: Turn a reference image into color inspiration for your photos. Transfer a mood, tune its strength, and make it your own.
en.intro: Sometimes the first thing I fall for in a photograph is its color. Color Muse turns that instinct into a small tool: give it a reference, and see what palette your own image might grow into.
features: Start with a palette
Upload a photo and choose a built-in style or your own reference image.
Find the right balance
Adjust the transfer strength and compare the before and after.
Keep creating
Download the image or export a .CUBE LUT to continue in another color-grading tool.
en.note: Image processing happens in your browser. Source code is available; a live link is still to come.
